items.headline: The candidate field is now set
items.summary: Nominations closed Aug. 21. Burlington's official list now shows the mayoral race plus council contests in all six wards.
items.why: You can now compare the people who will actually appear on the municipal ballot.

items.headline: Some ward boundaries changed for this election
items.summary: The 2026 map changes parts of Wards 1, 2, 3 and 4. Wards 5 and 6 are unchanged.
items.why: Your ward determines which councillor candidates you can vote for.

items.headline: Local candidate profiles are arriving quickly
items.summary: BurlingtonToday is publishing short Q&As with mayoral and ward candidates covering priorities, background and reasons for running.
items.why: These interviews can add detail when a campaign website is thin or has not published a full platform.
